Thanks — a few infra notes ahead of the call so we have realistic options:
1) 24 A100-eq sustained for 6 weeks (Orbital pilot) is feasible if we schedule it as a reserved burst block (not exclusive reserved pool) — we can guarantee throughput but would need to carve from burst inventory. Cost delta vs dedicated reserved is ~+35% during the window.
2) If they require an SLA-backed dedicated pool with isolation, we must move to reserved capacity and that requires a commit (monthly minimum) we can’t retroactively invoice.
3) Sequence length and KV cache retention are important — if Orbital's workflow uses long contexts we need to model memory pressure (could reduce effective concurrency by ~20%).

Can Ben/Priya confirm expected average and 95th percentile sequence lengths and whether they expect training-style workloads (longer context) or short-gen inference?
